<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex3042025-01-102" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Conclusive verses (118a6–118b2)"/><milestone unit="section" n="[2]"/> <lg><l>de las bsod nams thob des blo gros mchog ldan pa'i ||</l>
         <l>bshes gnyen dam <lb n="118b2"/> pa'i mgon gyis rgyun du rjes bzung ste ||</l>
         <l>'gro ba kun kyi ma rig 'thibs po dpyis 'byin pa'i ||</l>
         <l>chos kyi nyi chen dge legs 'byung gnas myur thob shog ||</l></lg></seg></TEI>
